# appgatesdp_identity_providers_names (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `banner_message` (String) Configured banner message to display before login.
- `data` (Attributes List) The list of the identity providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `auth_url` (String) Authorization endpoint URL for OIDC login.
- `certificate_priorities` (List of String) The prioritization of which client certificate to use.
- `certificate_san_type` (String) The Subject Alternative Name type the client should filter offered certificates by. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID for OIDC login.
- `google_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OIDC client secret for Google. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `name` (String) Name of the identity provider.
- `redirect_url` (String) The SAML login URL.
- `scope` (String) OIDC scope for getting user information.
- `token_url` (String) Token endpoint URL for OIDC login. Only present for public clients.
- `type` (String) The type of the identity provider.
